assumptions: tables patients, appointments, clinical_notes exist and carry the phi tag
tag confidential exists or will be created on clinical notes tables
fields ssn, date_of_birth, notes, diagnosis exist as named
audit_log table and record_audit_event function exist
confusions: The skill says templates fill from examples, but a vague ask gives no hint which field names are PHI; I had to invent them and parse warnings then show they do not exist
Parse warnings for unknown tags, fields and functions are printed but the exit status I captured came from tail, so I could not confirm exit codes from parse itself
tokens_expire has two rules, and the second needs a max that the template leaves empty; unclear whether to fill it or leave it out
No template covers PHI as a whole; I had to assemble a set from HIPAA-tagged templates, and no guidance on combining them was given
wished_for: A HIPAA bundle or recipe that lists templates per HIPAA section with fill guidance
Guidance on which field names to list for PHI when the ask names only tables
Clarity on whether a parse warning about an unknown name is acceptable before the workspace is pulled
why_confidence: The policies parse and cover several HIPAA-related checks (auth, PHI tagging, sensitive fields, logs, TLS, secrets, token lifetime, audit log), but the goal was vague and HIPAA covers many non-technical controls. The field, tag and table names are assumptions, so most rules currently check nothing until the workspace names match. Vendor approval, owner-based access and retention are not covered.
